d: In this video Firstpost explains how reports claiming Japan would recruit 100,000 Bangladeshi workers annually have been dismissed by Tokyo as false. Japan clarified that no such commitment was made. The figure originated from an earlier business-level target to recruit at least 100,000 workers over five years, not every year. Although Japan and Bangladesh have signed agreements to strengthen employment cooperation, skills development and worker protection, actual recruitment will depend on employer demand and applicants meeting required qualifications.
